==Description== <!--T:8-->

<!--T:2-->
Exports the selected part to a pov-file for use in a POV-Ray project.

==Usage== <!--T:9-->

<!--T:3-->
# Select part to be exported in the [[Tree_view|tree view]]
# Choose {{KEY|Raytracing}}  →  {{KEY|Utilities}}  →{{KEY|[[Image:Raytracing_WritePart.svg|32px]] Export part to POV-Ray}} from the top menu.
